answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. By the cipher of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The forge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the harbor.
